It rehashes every source/input and its own entrypoint, validates TRAIN/diagnostic/GPU1/hostname flags, enforces the exact8-sequence collection-prefix rule, then checks the completed witness links and full artifact tree. Admission is repeated before completion receipt emission.

native_command.evidence: Before model construction the new native record must be RUNNING with parent PID, exact task/hostname and CUDA-visible GPU1. Native.command must equal both [sys.executable]+sys.argv and canonical absolute project Python/script/plan/review paths with review SHA and exact task/run. CUDA device order and OpenCV thread environment are checked. R10-style relative executable/script mismatch is rejected.

fixed_TRAIN_selection.limits: A deterministic8-sequence prefix diagnostic is not representative population evaluation. Component holdout is within TRAIN and upstream E0 has seen this partition; no independent generalization is claimed.

causal_GT_boundary.evidence: Initial annotation is used only for first-frame initialization. Each later frame runs causal tracker.track and synchronization first; only then is that frame's box annotation read for IoU on valid indices. No overlap result or target is passed to tracker, M1/M2, candidate generation, state/history updates or model selection. Invalid-frame IoUs are blank. The existing TRAIN valid-frame schedule is retained rather than deriving a new gate from IoU.

original_E0_proposal_geometry.evidence: Captures pre-step base.state, reconstructs factor4 square crop center/side using the same float32 geometry conversion, maps observer.final_normalized_box from cxcywh to image xywh and applies identical clip_box margin10 and dtype. Observer records the final original E0 normalized output before M2 replaces state. No extra predictor/encoder forward is added by reconstruction. On non-invoked/no-match frames runtime requires array-exact agreement with returned box.
original_E0_proposal_geometry.CPU_test_cases: Three interior/boundary previous boxes x2 normalized boxes, including out-of-crop normalized centers; exact equality against actual crop_pair geometry and tracker conversion.
original_E0_proposal_geometry.qualification: This is the current E0 proposal from the shared already-intervened state/history/templates, not an independent E0 rollout. Positive-replacement frames correctly retain the pre-replacement observer output for conditional comparison. No real neural reconstruction was executed by this review.

trace_schema_and_IoU.evidence: CSV fields match writer keys: frame/valid/partition, M1 class/probabilities/template-write flags, M2 invocation/class/scores, e0_iou/output_iou and elapsed time. Unknown scores on uninvoked frames remain blank. IoU uses continuous xywh intersection/union consistent with the project diagnostic convention; unit tests verify identity, disjoint and1/3-overlap cases. Current manifest valid boxes are finite and positive; output positivity and observer/base frame counts are runtime checked.
trace_schema_and_IoU.limits: Raw candidate boxes/ROI features and a shadow E0 trajectory are not archived by this runner. Its per-step IoU comparison cannot prove full independent-counterfactual gain, candidate recall, or policy calibration.

observer_and_gate.evidence: Reviewed R2 class resets sequence diagnostics and inherits fresh anchor/templates/history/counters. Runner verifies cleared records, then one observed original E0 predict and matching frame on every step. M2 invocation must equal current predicted lost(state2) AND the existing sampled TRAIN cadence. No forced lost state or new threshold is introduced. Close restores original model.predict.
observer_and_gate.cadence_qualification: Most selected sequences have1+25k call opportunities, but invalid TRAIN intervals yield gonemoto_ab opportunities[1,26,51,76,136] and ab_motoinrain[1,26,51,76,115]. Thus these TRAIN schedules must not inherit the R15 full-TEST nonintersection proof. The reviewed new class never writes replacement templates regardless of cadence; M1 guards direct E0 writes.

frozen_weights.evidence: Exact parent/M1/M2/factory input identities are inherited from the hash-bound witness, rehashed and checked equal. Parent/factory strict loads and reviewed frozen eval M1/M2 loaders are reused. Main runs no_grad with no optimizer/backward, fixed seed2027, cost0 and disabled TF32. All3 module state_dict tensors must equal pre-run snapshots and all grads remain None.
frozen_weights.limits: Runtime state_unchanged means model state tensors unchanged, not tracker state unchanged. This review hashed checkpoint files but did not load their tensors or execute real models.

timing.evidence: Outer clocks cover image decode plus full initialization or full E0/M1/actual M2 call and end after CUDA synchronization. Geometry reconstruction/GT/IoU/CSV writing occur after elapsed time is captured. Model loading is excluded. Exactly3076 positive finite per-frame times are required. Partial inherited route.seconds is not used.
timing.limits: Concurrent execution diagnostic timing, not isolated performance evidence or a speed result from this review.

receipt.evidence: Fresh run directory and eight trace outputs/progress/config/timing form the hashed artifact tree before COMPLETE.json is emitted, excluding the receipt itself. Config includes full exact plan, initial plan SHA, review SHA and actual native command. Completion binds task/train/8-sequence/frame counts, final plan SHA, frozen state, zero optimizer/backward and M2 counts. Scope explicitly disclaims independent E0 control and TEST admission.
receipt.limits: A downstream reader must separately verify wrapper COMPLETE/exit0, review/config/plan/native and the exact artifact tree. Source admission does not mean that this new diagnostic has run or produced a valid receipt.
